title: multi-sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics + parity bumps (v1.127.0)
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Unify auth handling and retry semantics across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs
Improve streaming API ergonomics and docs for client-side consumption
Parity fixes to align argument names and default behaviors across SDKs
Version bumps to v1.127.0 for all SDK packages; backward-compatible
description: This PR unifies several cross-language SDK changes required by ENG-4821 and ENG-4899: (1) standardize auth header refresh and retry semantics across python/typescript/go SDKs so token refresh, retry backoff, and idempotency keys behave consistently; (2) improve streaming ergonomics (client-side iterators/async iter patterns, clear error propagation on network interruptions, and consistent end-of-stream markers); (3) parity fixes to argument names, defaults, and small API surface mismatches discovered during integration testing; (4) version bumps to v1.127.0 for release. Motivation: customers reported inconsistent retry behavior and poor ergonomics with streaming across languages which caused subtle production bugs and support tickets (SUP-2145). This change reduces cognitive load for multi-language product teams and enables consistent server-side routing/metrics. Checklist: updated SDK call flows and token refresh tests; end-to-end streaming demo updated; added compatibility layer when older clients omit new retry headers; bumped package versions and updated changelogs. Notes: changes are designed to be backwards-compatible; where defaults are tightened we added compatibility shims.
commits: 5 commits: 1) sdk: python auth/retry refactor + tests; 2) sdk: ts streaming ergonomic iterator + docs; 3) sdk: go retries idempotency key parity; 4) sdk: cross-lang tests and fixtures; 5) release: bump versions and changelogs
files_snippets: sdks/python/auth.py: added AuthSession.refresh_if_needed() and unified token header name 'Authorization' with 'Bearer' prefix enforcement
sdks/typescript/src/streaming.ts: introduced AsyncIterableStream wrapper to normalize onmessage/onclose semantics
sdks/go/retries/retries.go: added IdempotencyKey support and exponential jitter backoff aligned with other SDKs

ci_checks: CI passed on the third pipeline run. Summary: linux-python-tests (pass), linux-ts-tests (pass), go-build (flaky -> fixed, pass), lint (ts/python) (warnings resolved), e2e-streaming (pass). One flaky test (go module resolution) rerun after pinning dependency; all green before merge.
backcompat_and_migration: No action required for most users. For clients relying on undocumented retry headers, a compatibility shim preserves previous behavior for 90 days. Recommend patching to v1.127.0 to get bugfixes. Migration guide added to docs/sdks/auth-retries.md.
